content:
Maya: Heads-up — prepping a cross-subscription capacity reservation request for ND40rs in westeurope and eastus2. Need a quick sync on subscription IDs, quotas, and the networking port limit ask.

Raj: I can take the quota ticket for westeurope. Which subscription should I use for the reservation?

Maya: Use sub-prod-001 (subscription ID: 8a3f2e1b-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-9b7c4d2e5f6a). We'll want a 12x ND40rs reservation initially.

Elena: FYI we also hit an NSG rule limit during onboarding in eastus2 last week. Need to request increase for ephemeral ports (SNAT) and vCPU per-region as part of the same support case.

Jon: Can we bundle the NSG/SNAT and vCPU increases into the same support request to reduce churn? Azure support usually prefers one case with multiple quota SKUs.

Maya: Yes. Plan: one support case per region listing SKU quota increases + a capacity reservation. For westeurope: ND40rs x12, vCPUs +800, SNAT ephemeral ports +2000. For eastus2: ND40rs x8, fallback NC24s-v3 x10, vCPUs +400.

Raj: Drafted the case body and attached the cost estimate. Putting it here in case others want to edit before opening:```
Support case: SR-32567890
Region: westeurope
Subscription: 8a3f2e1b-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-9b7c4d2e5f6a
Requested:
  - Quota increase: ND40rs GPU instances -> +12
  - vCPU quota -> +800
  - SNAT ephemeral ports -> +2000
  - Capacity reservation preferred start: 2026-04-01
Reason: Q2 batch inferencing ramp; need predictable throughput and warm KV caches.
Cost impact: ~€55k/month if fully utilized.
```

Elena: Small edit: include a note that we require dedicated VNET integration and that subnets need 30 extra IP addresses for node readiness probes.

Maya: Good call. Added that. Also please add the tenant onboarding contact: infra-onboard@redwood.ai and point to the internal playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/azure-gpu-onboard

Jon: One more: ask Azure to reserve the quotas under the same billing account so we can apply reserved capacity discounts. Means they should link the capacity reservation to Billing ID: B-77412.

infra-bot: Reminder: we've used 3 support cases in the last 30 days for GPU quota. Escalation threshold for fast-track is 5 per 30d — consider opening an escalation if they push back. :warning:

Maya: Opening the westeurope case now. Will paste the case ID here once created. If they request resource group or ARM template for the reservation, here's the sample we can drop in:```json
{
  "name": "gpu-capacity-reservation",
  "type": "Microsoft.Compute/capacityReservations",
  "properties": {
    "sku": "ND40rs",
    "skuCapacity": 12,
    "region": "westeurope",
    "reservationStart": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

Raj: Ack. I queued the eastus2 case as SR-32567912 with NC fallback notes. I also pinged our account rep (elias@msft) for a fast-track.

azure-support-bot: Support case SR-32567890 created by Maya. Assigned to Azure GPU Onboarding Team. Initial response SLA: 24 hours. Case link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/SupportCase/CaseId/SR-32567890

Maya: Paste incoming response once you get it. If they ask for subscription-level service admin to approve, that'll be me (Maya).

Elena: Quick ops note — once reservations are provisioned, we need a pre-flight runbook: add routes, update autoscaler pool config, run smoke infer job against new nodes, verify KV cache warmup <10s. I'll author and drop in here.

Jon: Also record estimated cost per-token change for ND40rs vs NC24 fallback in the ticket so finance can pre-approve. Might save negotiations.

Maya: Good. Closing loop: I'll update SR-32567890 with the runbook link and the Billing ID. Back if Azure asks for anything else. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :rocket: by Raj, :eyes: by Elena, :white_check_mark: by Jon)
